description: This Java source file defines the MacroCommonRenderer class, which provides static utility methods for rendering macros in the OFBiz framework, including creating AJAX parameter strings and resolving link URLs based on context and link type.

classes.name: MacroCommonRenderer
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for rendering macros, creating AJAX parameters, and resolving link URLs within the OFBiz widget framework.

methods.name: createAjaxParamsFromUpdateAreas
methods.description: Generates a CSV string of AJAX update area parameters based on a list of UpdateArea objects, including optional extra parameters and anchor.

methods.name: buildParamStringFromMap
methods.description: Converts a map of parameters into a URL-encoded query string.

methods.name: getLinkUrl
methods.description: Resolves and constructs the URL for a given link object based on its type and context, supporting 'update-area', 'hidden-form', and default link types.
